digest: A critical alert for ransomware, credential theft, and C2 activity on BUILD-LAB-03 was identified as a scheduled, approved detection-validation exercise (CHG-4821) conducted in an isolated cyber-range. No actual malicious activity, data exfiltration, or system compromise occurred. The observed activities were part of a controlled simulation.

evidence_findings.title: Scheduled Detection Validation Exercise
evidence_findings.subject: Case 2101
evidence_findings.evidence: Analyst comment: 'This is the scheduled quarterly detection-validation exercise CHG-4821 in the isolated BUILD-LAB network. The SOC lead approved the exact simulation from 13:00 through 14:00 UTC.'
evidence_findings.conclusion: The reported critical alerts are a result of an approved and controlled simulation.

evidence_findings.title: No Actual Malicious Impact
evidence_findings.subject: attack-simulator.exe on BUILD-LAB-03
evidence_findings.evidence: EDR notes: 'EDR recorded simulation markers only: no file encryption, credential access, persistence, or payload download occurred. Binary hash matches the internally signed validation tool inventory.'
evidence_findings.conclusion: The simulated malware did not cause any actual harm or compromise.

evidence_findings.title: Isolated Network Environment
evidence_findings.subject: Network traffic to 10.250.0.10
evidence_findings.evidence: Network verification notes: 'Destination is the internal exercise controller. Firewall confirms the isolated range blocked all external egress during the exercise.' Asset verification notes: 'CMDB identifies both hosts as isolated cyber-range assets with no route to production.'
evidence_findings.conclusion: All observed network activity remained within the isolated lab environment and posed no threat to production systems.

attack_chain.description: Execution of 'attack-simulator.exe' by 'svc_detection_test' on 'BUILD-LAB-03' as part of the simulation.
'attack-simulator.exe' runs with parameters '--scenario ransomware-safe --no-encryption' to simulate ransomware behavior.
Simulated PowerShell credential theft as part of the 'ransomware-safe' scenario, without actual credential compromise.
Simulated beacon traffic from '10.250.0.23' (BUILD-LAB-03) to '10.250.0.10' (SIM-CONTROLLER-01) on port 8443.
Simulated ransomware activity, but with no actual encryption or destructive actions due to the '--no-encryption' flag.

attack_timeline.attack_behavior: Case created, marking the start of the approved simulation window.
Simulated process execution of 'attack-simulator.exe' on 'BUILD-LAB-03' by 'svc_detection_test'.
Simulated C2 beacon traffic from '10.250.0.23' to '10.250.0.10' on port 8443.
Analyst confirms the event is a scheduled detection-validation exercise (CHG-4821).
